name: critic-ledger
description: An adversarial critic round on a plan or an implementation, driven to closure by a fix-ledger. Parallel read-only critics under distinct lenses, refute-by-default adjudication that fixes an acceptance criterion per finding, targeted fix batches, independent per-finding verification by a different actor, a convergence signal and a programmatic terminality recount. Critic, fixer and verifier are separate subagent roles with their own agent definitions and per-role models; the ledger and the verbatim critic and verifier reports land in a per-run folder inside the project under review. An expensive multi-agent procedure: use ONLY on explicit user request.
